summary: Click To Do is a Copilot+ PC feature that suggests AI-powered actions whenever you select text or an image on screen. It can be turned off with a single toggle in privacy settings.

steps.path: Settings → Privacy & security → Click To Do → toggle off

regionNotes: Click To Do is exclusive to Copilot+ PCs with NPUs. Not present on standard Windows 11 installs.
whyTheyDidIt: Microsoft wants AI actions to feel ambient and always-available on Copilot+ hardware.

sources.label: Microsoft Support — Click To Do on Copilot+ PCs
MakeUseOf — I disabled all 10 AI features in Windows 11
